description: hexa enforces safety by refusing unsafe or ungated work, not by changing its interface

accepted.by: gary (in conversation, 2026-11-23: "accept the specs"; recorded by the implementing agent)

specs.description: harden refuses to start when tree is dirty
specs.given: a git repo with uncommitted changes
specs.when: hexa harden is called
specs.then: it exits with an error message about a clean tree requirement

specs.description: harden refuses to start when HEAD is not the branch tip
specs.given: a git repo where HEAD is behind the branch tip
specs.when: hexa harden is called
specs.then: it exits with an error message about HEAD not being the branch tip

specs.description: harden always checks tree cleanliness and HEAD position before starting
specs.given: any git repo state
specs.when: hexa harden is called
specs.then: it verifies the tree is clean and HEAD is the branch tip before proceeding

specs.description: do run commits only specified files
specs.given: a git repo with a root Cargo.toml and two files: src/main.rs (dirty) and src/lib.rs (clean)
specs.when: hexa do run --file src/lib.rs is called
specs.then: it commits only src/lib.rs, not src/main.rs

specs.description: do run refuses to commit dirty files without --include-dirty
specs.given: a git repo with a dirty file src/main.rs
specs.when: hexa do run --file src/main.rs is called without --include-dirty
specs.then: it exits with an error about the file being dirty

specs.description: do run never commits files outside the specified --file and --also
specs.given: any git repo state
specs.when: hexa do run is called with --file and/or --also
specs.then: it commits only the specified files, never the entire package

specs.description: hexa do gate runs evidence on an edit
specs.given: a git repo with a staged edit to src/main.rs
specs.when: hexa do gate --files src/main.rs --evidence 'cargo test' is called
specs.then: it runs 'cargo test' on the staged edit and commits src/main.rs if the test passes

specs.description: hexa do gate refuses to run without --files
specs.given: a git repo with staged edits
specs.when: hexa do gate --evidence 'cargo test' is called without --files
specs.then: it exits with an error about missing --files

specs.description: pre_bash blocks write-shaped commands without a gate
specs.given: a git repo with no gate recorded for the current task
specs.when: hexa pre_bash is called with 'sed -i s/a/b/ src/main.rs'
specs.then: it exits with code 2 to block the command

specs.description: pre_bash allows read-only commands without a gate
specs.given: a git repo with no gate recorded for the current task
specs.when: hexa pre_bash is called with 'cargo test'
specs.then: it exits with code 0 to allow the command

specs.description: pre_bash blocks write-shaped commands to tracked project paths without a gate
specs.given: any git repo state
specs.when: hexa pre_bash is called with a write-shaped command to a tracked project path
specs.then: it exits with code 2 if no gate is recorded for the current task

specs.description: gate fails on vacuous test results
specs.given: a test that runs with 0 tests
specs.when: hexa run_gate is called on the test output
specs.then: it returns Vacuous and fails the gate

specs.description: gate passes on non-vacuous test results
specs.given: a test that runs with 1 or more tests
specs.when: hexa run_gate is called on the test output
specs.then: it returns Pass and passes the gate

specs.description: every gate result goes through evidence_verdict and fails on Vacuous
specs.given: any gate result
specs.when: hexa run_gate is called
specs.then: it checks the result against evidence_verdict and fails if Vacuous

specs.description: harden includes stored lessons in its prompt
specs.given: a stored lesson 'lesson:async-staleness' matching the target
specs.when: hexa harden is called
specs.then: the prompt includes the lesson

specs.description: harden fails if a fix test passes without the fix
specs.given: a fix whose test passes without the fix applied
specs.when: hexa harden is called
specs.then: The fix is reported as "untested", never as "fixed"

specs.description: harden and build call the same lesson gathering as do run
specs.given: any git repo state
specs.when: hexa harden or hexa build is called
specs.then: they gather lessons the same way as do run

specs.description: skills CI check fails on broken skill lines
specs.given: a skill file with 'npx hexa summarize'
specs.when: hexa skills_name_real_commands is run
specs.then: it fails because 'npx hexa summarize' does not exist

specs.description: skills CI check passes on valid skill lines
specs.given: a skill file with 'hexa do gate --files src/main.rs'
specs.when: hexa skills_name_real_commands is run
specs.then: it passes because the command exists

specs.description: a CI check runs --help on every hexa command in skills
specs.given: any git repo state
specs.when: the CI check is run
specs.then: it verifies that every hexa command in skills has a valid --help output

specs.description: do gate commits exactly the files it names
specs.given: Any tree with an edit in each of the named files and any other modified tracked files, and evidence that reports passing tests
specs.when: `hexa do gate --files <named>… --evidence <cmd>` runs
specs.then: The commit it makes contains exactly the named files; every other modified file is still modified and uncommitted
